issues.description: The problem statement/UML specifies a SealSaloon method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int, but the solution implements the corresponding functionality as a static method named computeMealCost(Meal): int. If graders/tests (and students) follow the specified API name calculateTotalPrice, this mismatch can cause compilation/test failures and confusion about which method to implement/call.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename (or add a delegating wrapper) public static int computeMealCost(Meal meal) to public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal), and update any call sites accordingly.

issues.description: The problem statement text requires acceptSupplyDelivery(String,int,int) to be static, but the UML lists it as a normal instance method (+acceptSupplyDelivery...) without any static marker. This inconsistency can mislead students about whether the method should be called on the class or an instance and may lead to an API that does not match tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML in problem_statement.md to explicitly mark acceptSupplyDelivery as static (e.g., {static} or underlined) to match the textual requirement and intended design.

issues.description: The problem statement text requires calculateTotalPrice(Meal) to be static, but the UML lists calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int as a normal instance method (+calculateTotalPrice...) without a static marker. This contradiction can cause students to implement an instance method when tests expect a static method (or vice versa).
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML in problem_statement.md to mark calculateTotalPrice as static (e.g., {static} or underlined) to match the textual requirement about shared stock.

issues.description: The problem statement text requires the SealSaloon stock field to be static (shared across all instances) and final, but the UML association/field label 'stock' does not indicate static/final. This inconsistency can mislead students into implementing an instance stock rather than shared stock, impacting method static-ness and tests relying on shared inventory.
issues.suggestedFix: Amend the UML in problem_statement.md to indicate that stock is static (and ideally final) to match the textual requirement and intended shared-stock design.
